# descope_segment_connector (Resource)

Manages a Segment connector and its configuration in a Descope project. Orchestrate customer identity traits and signals from your Descope user journey with the Segment connector.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) A custom name for your connector.
- `project_id` (String) The ID of the Descope project that the connector belongs to. Changing this value will require the resource to be deleted and recreated.
- `write_key` (String, Sensitive) The Segment Write Key generated for the Descope service.

### Optional

- `browser_analytics` (Boolean) Load Segment's analytics.js library in your end users' browsers during flows, so Segment can recognize the same visitor across your sites. Loading the library sends no events on its own, and you choose which screens or actions load it.
- `description` (String) A description of what your connector is used for.
- `disabled` (Boolean) Whether the connector is disabled. This can be used to temporarily stop a connector from executing without fully deleting it.
- `host` (String) The base URL of the Segment API, when using a custom domain in Segment.
- `public_write_key` (String) The write key of your Segment JavaScript Website source. This is a different Segment source than the Write Key field, and unlike it this value is visible to end users, which is how Segment's browser library works.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
